dfmIssues.description: Wall 2.2 mm below gravity minimum 3 mm — Thin sections freeze before the cavity fills — cold shuts, misruns and non-fill scrap.
dfmIssues.impact: Wall 2.2 mm below gravity minimum 3 mm
dfmIssues.fix: Thicken to ≥ 3 mm, add flow ribs, raise metal/die temperature, or move to a process with lower min wall (investment 0.7 mm).

dfmIssues.description: Non-uniform sections (heavy:thin ≈ 33.6:1) — Heavy sections solidify last and shrink, drawing porosity/sink at the hot spot.
dfmIssues.fix: Even out wall thickness, core out heavy bosses, add fillets to taper transitions, or feed the hot spot with a riser/chill.

dfmIssues.description: Draft -1° below recommended 1° — Insufficient draft galls the die/pattern, raises ejection force and accelerates tool wear (or breaks the sand mould).
dfmIssues.fix: Add ≥ 1° draft on all as-cast vertical walls; deep pockets need more. Investment casting can run near-zero draft if this is fixed.
